title: Sugar Music
abstract:
The new visual identity of the Sugar Group stems from the desire to visually express the values of transformation, exploration, and openness that have always defined its work. The project involves Sugar Music and Sugar Music Publishing, with the aim of creating a coherent and recognizable graphic system, capable of adapting to the brand’s many facets. The new logo and visual system reflect a balance between heritage and modernity, between cultural roots and a forward-looking vision.

Sugar Music’s new identity was curated by Cabinet Milano and Nicola Narbone. Within the project, I collaborated on the development of the identity system, the custom typeface, and the logo design.
